name: BlackWarGreymon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's play cost 7 or lower Digimon or Tamers.
[All Turns] While your opponent has a Digimon with 13000 DP or more, your opponent's Digimon's effects don't affect this Digimon, and it gets +3000 DP.
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
